title: Advanced reported speech
grammar: Reported speech with multiple tenses, Reporting verbs
function: Report what others said with nuance

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn advanced reported speech structures, including reporting verbs like admit, deny, suggest, warn.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. He admitted stealing the money. She denied having seen him. They suggested going to the cinema. Notice how reporting verbs change the structure.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: She ___ me to close the window.
phases.explanation: Tell is used with an object pronoun: tell someone to do something.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Report a conversation you had recently using 3 different reporting verbs.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.explanation: Deny + gerund means to say that you did not do something.
